subject: Aurora: Invitation to Schedule Initial Technical Screen
body:
Hi Sourish,

We reviewed your application for the Software Engineer Intern role at Aurora and would love to schedule a 45-minute technical screen with one of our engineering leads.

Please select a time slot on my Calendly within the next 3 days: https://calendly.com/aurora-recruiting/tech-screen

Looking forward to speaking with you!
Aurora Talent Team
